referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the energy consumption required for the operation of the rail track as well as the operation of tunnels. The use and emissions to soil of herbicides (weed control) and lubricates (point maintenance) are taken into account. Also land transformation and occupation are accounted for.
